class.name: IfcResourceLevelRelationship
class.brief_description: IfcResourceLevelRelationship is an abstract base class for relationships between resource-level entities. HISTORY New Entity in IFC 2x4
class.description: Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files.

members.member: A name used to identify or qualify the relationship. A String, or null when unset.
A description that may apply additional information about the relationship. A String, or null when unset.
